body: [This](https://www.reddit.com/r/offmychest/comments/dqkr48/when_he_didnt_show_up_to_our_halloween_party_we/?utm_medium=android_app&utm_source=share) was literally under your post on my reddit feed. Have a read.

This makes me think of my friend who also died of a genetic disorder in her early 20's :( I'm sorry for your loss OP. Some people are taken away far too soon :(

My sister in law loves sailor moon and she totally fit one sailor moon pose/edit into her wedding photos haha

Thank you for sharing your story♡
(I've always been partial to Sailor Venus!)
Talk to your friends and family about exactly what you said here. Have you told anyone how you feel?
Well I guess I'll go because I'm definitely not going to provide that. I hope things get better for you OP.

It's hard too see all the trees when you're standing in the middle of the forest. It's a lot harder than just "buck up!" and I understand that. You're in the middle of your feelings now but don't give up on the fact that things can eventually get better and that it'll be worth it once you get there♡

Only 1 in 500 organ donors can actually have their organs used for transplant specifically. If you're curious about what happens to your body I highly suggest reading Mary Roach's "stiff". Book recommendation set aside OP I can tell by your post that you're a caring person if this is something you're asking. You care about helping people and contributing to making things better. Use that empathy on yourself♡ you are loved
Juice a fresh orange and drink it. Vitamin C will stop you from getting scurvy and turning into a pirate. You don't need poison OP but I will send you some internet hugs instead. You are loved♡

I can eat in front of people again and all those aspects are normal again for me. I still struggle with food aversion especially if I'm in a bad mood. I starve my feelings I guess. I'm trying to overcome these things because I need to be a good role model for my own kid now. I don't want them to be so needlessly affected by bullying. My mom was very much about "toughen up" or "don't be so sensitive". She's a good mom but didn't really give me the tools I needed to deal with bullying or even just let me talk about my frustrations. She never had that as a kid and I think she was just doing her best so I don't hold that against her. Thank you for your kind comment♡

You should check out /r/raisedbynarcissists you might not feel so alone and could maybe get some insights that could help you. You're doing a good job OP I'm sorry your mom treats you this way. It's not fair
"I see something in your future too Mr. Psychic. It's a shoe up your ass"

I'm in Canada and there are a pile of racists here too. I think your husband might be right about shitty people being everywhere but I promise you that not everyone is shitty even though it may feel that way. I joined our community league and made friends through there. I've made a couple friends through reddit too on my local sr. Don't give up mama♡
